sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2025
sources.text: While underway, four perpetrators armed with knives were sighted in the engine room.  The ship’s general alarm was immediately activated and a search was conducted, with no perpetrators found onboard. All crew members were safe and accounted for, with no injury reported. Three paint drums were stolen. The incident was reported to Singapore POCC. Upon arrival in Singapore, Singapore PCG boarded the ship, conducted a search and confirmed no perpetrators were onboard.
